recognize_zh: 中倍 H&E 下可見混雜多種細胞的淋巴浸潤：小淋巴球、帶偏心核的漿細胞樣細胞，以及核大、染色質疏鬆、具核仁的免疫母細胞，並有分裂象；這種從小細胞到大細胞的連續成熟譜系，符合多形性移植後淋巴增生性疾病（polymorphic PTLD）。
features: Polymorphous lymphoid infiltrate spanning small lymphocytes to large cells
Scattered large immunoblast-like cells with vesicular chromatin and distinct nucleoli
Plasmacytoid cells and plasma cells with eccentric nuclei
Mitotic figures present, including an atypical-appearing form
Loose pale fibrillary background with small vessels and a few eosinophilic cells
describe_en: Section shows a diffuse polymorphous lymphoid infiltrate composed of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid cells and plasma cells, and scattered large immunoblast-like cells with vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli, set in a loose fibrillary background. Mitotic figures are present. The infiltrate shows a spectrum of B-cell maturation rather than monotonous sheets of large atypical cells. In a transplant recipient, the findings are consistent with polymorphic post-transplant lymphoproliferative disorder; EBER in situ hybridization, CD20/CD3 and kappa/lambda studies, and clonality testing are recommended.

ddx.dx: Monomorphic PTLD (diffuse large B-cell lymphoma type)
ddx.vs: Monomorphic PTLD consists of sheets of large transformed cells meeting criteria for lymphoma, without the full maturation spectrum.
cHL-type PTLD contains CD30+/CD15+/CD45- Reed-Sternberg cells in a reactive background, whereas polymorphic PTLD immunoblasts are CD20+ and CD45+.
Rejection is T-cell predominant with target tissue injury, lacks EBER-positive B immunoblasts and destructive expansion.
Non-destructive PTLD preserves the underlying architecture, whereas polymorphic PTLD effaces it.
